items.title: Regulations Implementing the Privacy Act
items.summary: The Occupational Safety and Health Review Commission (OSHRC) is proposing revisions to its regulations implementing the Privacy Act of 1974. The proposed amendments to the Privacy Act regulations provide additional information on how to submit a Privacy Act request and revise the requirements for verifying a requester's identity.

items.title: Senior Leader of the Sinaloa Cartel and One of FBI’s Ten Most Wanted Fugitives Arrested in Mexico Following a Homeland Security Task Force Investigation
items.summary: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores , also known as “Chapo Isidro,” an alleged leader of the Sinaloa Cartel, has been captured by the Mexican military following a Homeland Security Task Force Investigation.

items.title: Former L.A. Resident Found Guilty of Federal Charges for Deliberately Starting What Became the Palisades Fire Last Year
items.summary: A former Los Angeles resident was found guilty by a jury today of starting what became the Palisades Fire of January 2025, the most destructive wildfire in the city’s history.

items.title: EU and Indonesia sign ambitious trade and investment agreements
items.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 21 Nov 2026 The European Union and Indonesia today signed their Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), and Investment Protection Agreement (IPA).

items.title: Commission partially greenlights Malta's final payment request for €61.7 million under NextGenerationEU
items.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 20 Nov 2026 Today, the European Commission partially greenlighted Malta's fifth and final payment request for €61.7 million under the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF), the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU.
